description: Maryland Coastal Atlas is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Maryland Department of Natural Resources; Maryland Energy Administration; NOAA Office for Coastal Management. State and local decision makers can access maps depicting sensitive coastal habitats, living resources, and human uses to inform their coastal planning processes. The atlas gives users a way to share spatial information early in the planning process, helping them to identify potential conflicts so that they can then be avoided or addressed. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
